notes: Read the full 123-line source with numbered lines before editing.
L1-10 doc comment (rolling N-day status grid; oldest left; hover/tap reveals status+summary popover; caption shows uptime %; synthesized-data note): preserved/expanded in the native file header.
L12 `import { useMemo } from 'react'`: kept and extended to `useMemo, useCallback, useState` (useState/useCallback drive the tap-to-reveal popover that replaces the DOM hover Tooltip).

L13 `import { GlassPanel, Tooltip } from '@/components/ui'`: GlassPanel -> native components/ui/GlassPanel; Tooltip -> removed (no hover / :focus-within / DOM popover on native) and reimplemented as a tap-to-toggle popover beneath the grid.
L14 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'`: dropped — native uses StyleSheet + style arrays instead of className merging.

L15 `import { fmtPercent } from '@/lib/numberFormat'`: ported inline as a local fmtPercent (Intl.NumberFormat('en-US') with non-finite->0 guard + toFixed fallback) reproducing web fmtNumber+fmtPercent for the 'NN.NN% uptime' caption.
L16 `import type { HeroStatus } from './StatusHero'`: StatusHero not yet in native parity tree, so the HeroStatus union is defined + exported locally for a future re-export.
L18-24 UptimeDay interface (date, status: HeroStatus, summary?): preserved verbatim with the same JSDoc.

L26-34 UptimeHeatmapProps (days, title?, footnote?, className?, id?): days/title/footnote preserved; `className` -> `style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>` (native), `id` -> kept and applied as the panel nativeID + fallback testID; added optional `testID` for native test targeting.

L36-42 SQUARE_BG (per-status `bg-*-400/80 hover:bg-*-300`, zinc-500/40 hover:zinc-400/60): ported to STATUS_VISUAL.fill/active resolved colours — green-400/80 #4ade80@.8 / green-300 #86efac; amber-400/80 / amber-300 #fcd34d; red-400/80 / red-300 #fca5a5; zinc-500/40 / zinc-400/60; blue-400/80 #60a5fa@.8 / blue-300 #93c5fd. The web :hover brighten maps to the Pressable pressed + selected states.
L44-50 STATUS_LABEL (Operational/Degraded/Outage/Unknown/Maintenance): preserved verbatim as STATUS_VISUAL.label; web has no i18n so strings are ported as-is.
L52-58 UptimeHeatmap signature/destructure: preserved (className->style, id kept, testID added).
L59-63 uptimePct useMemo (null when empty; (healthy+maintenance)/total*100): ported verbatim including the dependency array [days].
L65 `heading = title ?? `Uptime — last ${days.length} days``: preserved verbatim (em-dash retained).
L67-68 `<GlassPanel id className=cn('p-4', className)>`: -> native GlassPanel nativeID={id} testID={testID??id} style={[styles.panel(p-4 -> padding spacing.md), style]}.

L69-70 header `flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 mb-3` + h3 `text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]`: -> styles.header (row, alignItems baseline, justifyContent space-between, gap spacing.sm, marginBottom spacing.md) + heading AppText (fontSize 14, fontWeight 600, colors.textPrimary).

L71-80 uptime span (`text-xs font-medium tabular-nums` + green/amber/red by >=99 / >=95 thresholds, `fmtPercent(uptimePct, 2) uptime`): -> conditional AppText (fontSize 12, fontWeight 500, fontVariant ['tabular-nums']) with dynamic uptimeColor (#4ade80 / #fbbf24 / #f87171) and the same `${fmtPercent(uptimePct, 2)} uptime` text.
L83-87 grid `flex flex-wrap gap-1 role=list aria-label='Daily status history'`: -> View styles.grid (row, flexWrap wrap, gap spacing.xs) with accessibilityLabel 'Daily status history'.
L88-89 `days.map` + `role=listitem key=day.date`: preserved as days.map keyed by day.date (listitem wrapper folded into the Pressable square).

L90-103 `<Tooltip multiline content={date + STATUS_LABEL + optional summary with border-t}>`: replaced by the tap-to-toggle popover — selecting a square renders styles.popover (date semibold, status label, optional summary with borderTop rgba(255,255,255,0.06)+paddingTop, maxWidth 260 == multiline max-w-[260px]).

L94-100 popover content (date `text-xs font-semibold`, status `text-xs`, summary `text-xs pt-1 border-t border-white/[0.06]`): -> popoverDate/popoverStatus/popoverSummary AppText styles with the summary divider preserved; the `day.summary && ...` guard becomes an explicit `selectedDay.summary ?` ternary.

L113-116 close Tooltip/listitem/map + div: structurally reproduced by the Pressable list + popover render.

footnote
